core_obligations: Fix the determinant constructions of the surrounding section, including the canonical element on the determinant of the middle term of a short exact sequence and the functoriality of the two-factor decomposition (statement span, and the cited same-chapter lemmas).
Exploit the switch of the two determinant factors to relate the two maps under comparison (cited lemma-det-switch in the counted proof span).
Compare the resulting determinants on the local ring and reduce the surjectivity assertion to a unit condition (proof span).
Conclude the stated homotopy-theoretic surjectivity from that unit condition (statement conclusion).
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a local ring, bounded complexes of finite free modules, and two maps between them that become equal after choosing a determinant and a homotopy, and concludes a surjectivity statement that characterises when the relevant determinant is a unit (source statement span). The proof works through the determinant constructions of the surrounding section: it has to track the functoriality of det on a short exact sequence and the switch of the two factors, which is why the counted spans invoke the same-chapter lemmas lemma-det-ses-functorial, lemma-det-switch and the canonical-element lemma, and then compare the resulting unit conditions on the local ring (proof span). The non-routine part is the reduction of a statement about homotopy classes to a unit condition on a determinant.
